summary: Add the new columns with a two-way sync trigger, backfill, deploy, retire, then drop the old column.

stages.description: A BEFORE trigger keeps note and (note_title, note_body) consistent in both directions.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN note_title text
ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN note_body text
CREATE TRIGGER migproto_split_note_sync BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON account_user FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION migproto_split_note_sync()

WITH batch AS (SELECT id FROM account_user WHERE note IS NOT NULL AND note_body IS NULL LIMIT 1000) UPDATE account_user u SET note_title = CASE WHEN position(': ' in u.note) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE substr(u.note, 1, position(': ' in u.note) - 1) END, note_body = CASE WHEN position(': ' in u.note) = 0 THEN u.note ELSE substr(u.note, position(': ' in u.note) + 2) END FROM batch WHERE u.id = batch.id

stages.description: Deploy the new version; its migration only updates Django state.
Remove the sync machinery and the old column.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note
